# AfricanMRR

> Verified monthly recurring revenue (MRR) for African startups. Founders connect Paystack, Flutterwave or Stripe; AfricanMRR reads active subscriptions directly from the provider, normalizes every plan interval and currency to a monthly USD figure, and publishes a tamper-proof verified number. No screenshots, no self-reported vanity metrics.

## Pages
- [Leaderboard](https://africanmrr.com/leaderboard): Top 100 African startups ranked by verified MRR, with month-over-month growth.
- [Startups](https://africanmrr.com/startups): Searchable, filterable directory of startups (by category and country).
- [Marketplace](https://africanmrr.com/marketplace): Startups listed for sale with revenue multiples backed by verified MRR.
- [Developers](https://africanmrr.com/developers): Public API and MCP server documentation.

## API (public, JSON, no auth)
- `GET /api/startups` — List verified startups. Query params: `verified` (bool), `category`, `per_page` (max 100).
- `GET /api/startups/{slug}` — A single startup's full profile, including MRR history.
- `GET /api/leaderboard` — Top startups by verified MRR (param: `limit`, max 100).

## MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Streamable HTTP endpoint: `https://africanmrr.com/mcp`
- Tools: `search_startups`, `get_startup`, `leaderboard`

## Notes
- Supported payment providers: Paystack, Flutterwave, Stripe. Monnify is not supported (no native subscription product).
- MRR is normalized to USD for ranking; local currency is preserved for display.
